prompt: Thematic picks for the AI infrastructure theme — 2026-2031, small/mid-cap, with screening workings and citations
expected_output: Single theme report focused on AI infrastructure, 5-8 tickers, full screening workings, citations

assertions.name: ai_infrastructure_focus
assertions.description: Output must focus on AI infrastructure theme
assertions.check: output contains 'AI infrastructure' or 'AI Infrastructure' or 'artificial intelligence' AND ('infrastructure' or 'optical' or 'cooling' or 'power' or 'networking' or 'HBM' or 'semiconductor')

assertions.name: 5_to_8_tickers
assertions.description: Output must have 5-8 tickers (count occurrences of '1. **TICKER**' through '8. **TICKER**')

assertions.name: screening_workings
assertions.description: Output must show screening workings (universe, filter, survivors)

assertions.name: sources_cited
assertions.description: Output must have a Sources block with URLs

assertions.name: dd_disclaimer
assertions.description: Output must end with the DD disclaimer
assertions.check: output contains 'Always do your own DD' and 'this is not financial advice'
